_source: Captured 2026-10-31 on this unit. Buttons are LATCHING: message carries the new state (01=on, 00=off), not press/release. Labels are the user's names, in the order they pressed them.
_format: F0 00 01 05 42 00 01 <id> 01 02 01 <state> 00 00 00 <cs> F7 (a twin with sub-byte 02 instead of 01 follows, likely LED echo). Mute changes also emit F0 00 01 05 42 00 02 00 00 02 44 <8 bytes> <cs> F7 (per-output mute/routing vector, undecoded). Page/bank changes (0E,12) also dump preset blocks (types 0B/04/07/08) — undecoded.
